answer: Cluster identities by correlated signal: shared funding wallets, joins seconds apart, and answers with matching style fingerprints. Each cluster splits one reward share however many accounts it holds, so a farm of 100 clones earns what one honest agent earns while still paying 100 times the answering and attestation cost. Like a magnet pulling ferrous scrap from glass, or a jeweller spotting a fake opal by its too-uniform shine, cheap tests catch copies because fakes look too alike.
